text:
maria-g: Quick heads-up — pushing a config-only deploy in a 30m narrow change window to adjust routing QoS and batch_size defaults. Will pin model variant to 'redwood-1.1-quant' for this rollout.
chris-k: SGTM. What are the exact params? We should limit burst tokens and reduce max_batch to avoid tail latency.
maria-g: Planned changes:
```json
{"routing_policy":"latency_preferred","max_batch_size":8,"batch_window_ms":25,"request_timeout_ms":8000,"burst_tokens_per_min":1000}
```
lee: Can we add a temporary route weight to prefer dedicated-pool for premium keys? +1 on lower batch size.
maria-g: Yes — will set route_weights: {"dedicated-pool":0.7, "hosted":0.3} for the window.
ashley: Add a canary at 5% first and watch p50/p95/p99. If p95 increases >200ms, rollback. :warning:
oncall-bot: Incident oncall: @lee assigned for monitoring.
deploy-bot: Starting deploy: config-only /changes/1711501234 -> applying to env=prod, canary=5% (rolling), owner=maria-g
chris-k: Metrics to watch: runtime/p95_latency, token_cost_per_request, tail_oom_count, serving_error_rate. I'll wire a dashboard panel now.
maria-g: Rolling in. Canary batch size 8, batch_window 25ms applied to route 'chat-gen'. Pin variant redwood-1.1-quant.
deploy-bot: Canary applied successfully at 5% (hosts: rp-12, rp-19). Monitoring for 15m.
ashley: Also lower client timeout to 7s in the route override so downstreams fail fast.
lee: Noted. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler signals; reduce upscaling aggressiveness during window to avoid massive bursts.
maria-g: If we see error_rate >0.5% or latency regression >10% on p95 vs baseline -> immediate rollback. Call target rollback command: `/deploy rollback --pin=redwood-1.0-stable --reason="latency/regression"`
chris-k: p95 baseline copied to temp dashboard for quick comparison.
oncall-bot: Alert rule created: noise-filtered p95 delta > 10% for chat-gen, paging to oncall.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 15 minutes. Health checks: ok (errors=0.02%, p95:+3%). Increasing to 20% for 10m.
maria-g: Proceed. Thanks everyone. If all good after 30m we’ll ramp to 100% and remove temporary client-timeout override.
ashley: I'll prepare rollback notes and update the release notes channel if we hit rollback.
lee: One more thing — keep KV cache warm flag true for this rollout (avoid cold start tail).
chris-k: Confirmed. Dashboard shows stable memory and reuse rate at 92%.
maria-g: 35m into window — metrics look within thresholds. Proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: Deploy complete: config-only applied to 100% at ts=1711501450. Rollback window: 60m. Owner: maria-g
ashley: Added post-deploy checklist to docs. Will do a follow-up note in #eng-releases with change summary.
maria-g: Closing thread — no rollback needed. :tada:
